people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek to Yahweh. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
translations.bsb: Jehoshaphat was alarmed and set his face to seek the LORD. And he proclaimed a fast throughout Judah.
translations.kjv: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
translations.asv: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek unto Jehovah; and he proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
